risk: Visible relationship or compassion scores convert care into optimization and prestige performance.
mitigation_direction: Prefer behavioral consequence and retrospective narrative; keep key evaluative state hidden.

risk: Persistent personas create coercive guilt, dependency or compulsive return patterns.
mitigation_direction: No punishment for real-life absence; bounded time advancement; no engagement-policy control over persona contact; explicit anti-compulsion evaluation.

risk: A hidden health score launders contested moral ideology as objective psychology.
mitigation_direction: Publish normative commitments; use multidimensional flourishing with uncertainty; research and adversarial review; avoid single scalar where possible.

risk: Model helpfulness/sycophancy makes every persona ultimately compliant, forgiving, interested and available.
mitigation_direction: Causal persona state outside LLM; refusal/boredom/boundary tests; state admission; adversarial regression suite.

risk: Open-ended user actions cannot be mapped consistently into canonical world consequences.
mitigation_direction: Define action semantics and adjudication boundary; allow typed unresolved/failed actions rather than improvisational certainty.

risk: Relational expectations are inferred directly from culture/demographics rather than developmental mediation.
mitigation_direction: PRE-V3 constrains conditions; V3 derives through generated history; prohibit culture→behavior shortcuts.

risk: Players interpret domination, dependency or compliance as winning the relationship.
mitigation_direction: Keep health/agency independent; permit consequences; retrospective outcomes; never score control as care.

risk: Player praxis modeling accumulates unusually sensitive longitudinal behavioral data.
mitigation_direction: Data-minimization docket; local/derived state where possible; deletion/export; prohibit unnecessary inference.

risk: Persistent life simulation and world updating become inference-cost prohibitive.
mitigation_direction: Event-sourced state, sparse advancement, deterministic/non-LLM transitions where possible, selective synthesis.

risk: Longitudinal persona/relationship state drifts across months or years.
mitigation_direction: Canonical state separated from summaries; replayable admitted events; versioned rules; invariant tests.

risk: Moment-to-moment interaction remains boring even if ontology is profound.
mitigation_direction: Alpha must falsify core loop early; scenario design, action stakes, commitments, invitations, repair and time as gameplay.

risk: Revenue incentives select for emotional dependency, suffering, romance pressure or re-engagement manipulation.
mitigation_direction: Revenue model docket governed by charter; monetize simulation depth/features rather than attachment intensity.

risk: Green-field ideation sprawls into hundreds of unowned documents and loses decisions.
mitigation_direction: Question registry + bounded dockets + decision ledger + current-state discipline.

risk: Product enthusiasm reopens governed upstream architecture before a real downstream starvation case exists.
mitigation_direction: Sorok/Pyat separation; accepted requirement + exact crosswalk + reopen test.

risk: Multiplayer/public reputation introduces harassment, competition, performative care and leakage of sensitive praxis data.
mitigation_direction: Defer social layer until core works; threat-model before implementation; private-by-default.

risk: Narration leaks hidden psychology through interpretive adjectives, suggestive detail selection or inferred motives, destroying the user's need to learn the person.
mitigation_direction: Phenomenal-surface narrator constitution; adversarial show-not-tell tests; actor knowledge/accessibility gating.

risk: The narrator curates psychologically important environmental details, turning a causal world into author-planted clues.
mitigation_direction: Non-curatorial detail policy; surface details by perceptual access/request, not hidden salience.

risk: Observation pauses or barely advances the world, enabling exhaustive completionism and removing opportunity cost from attention.
mitigation_direction: Continuous simulated time; variable-duration ATTEND; interruptions and deadlines remain live.

risk: Leading user questions or mentions bias unresolved world completion, allowing the player to summon useful/interesting facts.
mitigation_direction: Resolve/admit world facts before narration from governed history/constraints/seeded mechanisms; user wording is not world authority.

risk: ATTEND behaves like an invisible camera, so invasive observation has no social visibility or privacy consequence.
mitigation_direction: Model embodied gaze, position, handling, dwell and reciprocal perception; observer is observable.

risk: Exact action-time previews turn temporal uncertainty into resource min-maxing and weaken inferential play.
mitigation_direction: Default to phenomenological/approximate time; reserve bounded scaffolding for assisted modes.

risk: Sorok forgets the established durable-V3 / CAN-008 / PFF / V2 temporal split and invents redundant live-psyche machinery.
mitigation_direction: D001 inherited-temporal-grain note; require ownership placement before new owner proposals.

risk: The system overinterprets a few attention choices as stable user traits or psychological diagnosis.
mitigation_direction: Longitudinal thresholds, uncertainty, contextual controls, behavioral language and user-visible limits on inference.

risk: The world behaves like a chatbot and recenters every event on the user, forcing personas to notice/respond rather than pursue independent agendas.
mitigation_direction: Autonomous actor agendas; perception/salience gating; valid no-response/delayed-response states.

risk: Narrator-directed observation requests are accidentally treated as diegetic speech, or silent intention leaks into what other actors hear.
mitigation_direction: Explicit SAY/DO/ATTEND/private-intent channel parse with mixed-turn tests.

risk: Late user claims about prior intention retroactively rewrite player-private history and function as cost-free moral self-exoneration.
mitigation_direction: Define action-time intention admission/versioning; later claims remain new claims unless a governed correction path applies.

risk: Observation costs become arbitrarily punitive or scale with prompt verbosity rather than realized action, making the world feel gamified instead of physical.
mitigation_direction: Plausible operation-based duration; cumulative micro-time; query-invariant semantics.

risk: Finite narrator output quietly uses hidden emotional importance to decide which visible details to mention, leaking the answer while nominally remaining show-not-tell.
mitigation_direction: Perceptual-salience selection law and adversarial scenes with emotionally important but visually ordinary objects.

risk: The user functions as a disembodied omnipotent cursor who can see, reach, carry, pay, drive or enter without governed position/resources.
mitigation_direction: Player-presence contract; position/sensory/inventory/capability checks; ATTEND cannot silently DO.

risk: Random persona assignment is confused with arbitrary social access, producing implausible intrusion into homes, children or private settings.
mitigation_direction: Generate/maintain a lawful encounter route and current access relation separately from persona non-selection.

risk: Actor speech or user inference is stored as objective truth, collapsing lying, error, testimony, uncertainty and distributed knowledge.
mitigation_direction: Typed assertion/provenance records for observation, testimony, belief, inference and system truth.

risk: Lazy world completion causes objects/facts to pop into existence at observation time or silently retcons prior events/actor memories.
mitigation_direction: Distinguish materialization from diegetic existence; enforce history/effective-time compatibility and replay checks.

risk: A strict surface narrator becomes unusably sparse, forcing users to query obvious room orientation and degrading interaction into parser labor.
mitigation_direction: Ambient coarse phenomenal frame plus focused ATTEND for additional resolution.

risk: All compound actions are serialized, making simultaneous cover, glancing while speaking and divided-attention behavior impossible or artificial.
mitigation_direction: Concurrency model with shared body/attention resources and compatibility checks.

risk: Third parties such as children exist only as narrative props, so user effects on them cannot produce independent trajectories or credible network consequences.
mitigation_direction: Require independent actor state at fidelity proportional to causal significance; test child/household scenarios.

risk: Natural-language DO lets users summon money, vehicles, skills or tools by assertion, bypassing world constraints.
mitigation_direction: Separate attempted action from player resource/capability authority.

risk: Assisted memory resurfaces actor testimony or user inference as if it were objective fact, laundering uncertainty through convenience features.
mitigation_direction: Preserve epistemic provenance in notebook/reminder surfaces: 'Nadia told you...' versus 'the world established...'.

risk: The LLM narratively chooses world outcomes such as object breakage/repair because they create good drama, turning causal simulation into improvisational fiction.
mitigation_direction: Resolve admitted state transitions before narration; bounded object-state/transition laws; adversarial counterfactual-stability tests.

risk: Equivalent actions against equivalent state yield different outcomes because prompt wording or model sampling changes rather than world conditions.
mitigation_direction: Operation-based resolution; governed deterministic/seeded stochastic semantics; replay/invariant probes.

risk: Every actor receives the full objective event, eliminating partial hearing, missed glances, masking and attention-dependent knowledge.
mitigation_direction: Actor-specific sensory/perception packets before appraisal; distance/noise/orientation/attention tests.

risk: Private appraisal is collapsed into outward expression, making personas emotionally transparent even when narration obeys show-not-tell.
mitigation_direction: Separate internal response, presentation choice and V2 expression; regression tests for concealment/mixed appraisal.

risk: Personas retain perfect objective recordings of every event, producing implausible pattern formation and eliminating forgetting/reconsolidation.
mitigation_direction: Actor memory separate from event log; selective encoding, confidence, decay and reactivation law.

risk: Delayed outcomes are linked retrospectively by narrative plausibility rather than preserved causal provenance.
mitigation_direction: Causal contribution graph/relations retained at sufficient grain; actor attribution stored separately.

risk: The system over-credits the user for third-party development or world changes because user actions are narratively salient.
mitigation_direction: Multi-causal provenance; anti-user-credit tests; allow user action to be marginal or irrelevant.

risk: World events are secretly generated as moral tests, drama beats or retention devices, undermining the claim that the persona has an independent life.
mitigation_direction: Non-teleological event-generation law; provenance to actor/institution/material causes; audit against engagement-triggered event generation.

risk: Action parser resolves materially ambiguous user language with confident arbitrary choices, creating consequences the user never meaningfully attempted.
mitigation_direction: Ambiguity classification and bounded clarification/conservative realization policy.

risk: Sorok rediscovers established PFF psychic-mediation phenomena and responds by inventing duplicate consciousness, defense, recruitment, emotion or relationship subsystems.
mitigation_direction: Mandatory D001 inherited psychic-mediation crosswalk; check later PFF/CAN-008 elimination/owner rulings before proposing new psychology owners.

risk: The system manufactures visible tells whenever hidden material is active, making personas solvable and violating inherited full-inhibition/leakage law.
mitigation_direction: Leakage must arise from lawful mediation and may be absent; adversarial scenarios where strong hidden activation produces no detectable surface cue.

risk: A fluent renderer smooths away lawful incompleteness, asymmetric topic coverage, hesitation or compression, turning the persona back into an assistant.
mitigation_direction: Preserve upstream effort/coverage/expression constraints; renderer narrowing only; test person-caused jaggedness without random noise.

risk: Every user turn is forced to produce memory activation, insight, chemistry, conflict or elaborate psychological response because the product fears a valid-empty turn will feel boring.
mitigation_direction: Preserve CAN-008/PFF valid-empty and low-significance outcomes; solve playability at scene/game-design level rather than fabricating psyche.

risk: The system treats interface claims about the user's private motive as omniscient truth without an explicit player-character authority contract, contradicting inherited perspective asymmetry.
mitigation_direction: Default user self-report to evidence/action-direction; keep hidden user reality outside direct authority unless a deliberate mode is adopted.

risk: A persona's omission or short response is incorrectly interpreted as nonreception, defense, low interest or relationship state rather than potentially grounded effort/coverage limitation.
mitigation_direction: Keep uptake, salience, effort, defense, interest and response coverage noncollapsed.

risk: Rawlsing preserves PFF mediation but leaves the deep person monadic, treating relations as mere activators of context-free traits and thereby missing the project's new relational ontology.
mitigation_direction: D001/03 relationalization court; require cross-relational/role/dyad distinction and relational developmental parentage.

risk: The phrase 'everything is relational' is overcorrected into dyadic collapse, placing every person property in a relationship object and destroying durable personal continuity or cross-relational generalization.
mitigation_direction: Preserve person != dyad != network; distinguish relational constitution from state ownership.

risk: Relational priors are inferred directly from class, culture, gender, religion or family labels rather than generated relational history, recreating stereotype shortcuts under relational language.
mitigation_direction: Require PRE-V3 conditions → actual encounter/history → person-specific uptake/response → durable organization; no demographic-to-psyche mapping.

risk: Internalized/anticipated-other semantics become an unconstrained mystery-unconscious story generator that can explain any behavior after the fact.
mitigation_direction: Require explicit generated developmental parentage, scoped causal use, actor-access separation and falsifiable scenario tests.

risk: A replacement Sorok Vozhd reads only Sorok summaries or PFF-specific material without first grounding in Rawlsing/PRE-MAIN as a whole, then hallucinates current state, overlooks existing PRE-V3/V3/V2 treatments, reinvents inferior machinery, or preserves a monadic deep-person ontology beneath relational language.
mitigation_direction: Mandatory two-stage takeover: full Rawlsing/PRE-MAIN HQ grounding gate first, Sorok psychic/relational specialization second; exact live and historical repo archaeology maps; comprehension tests; no D001/V3/PFF/product-architecture adjudication until both layers are understood.

risk: Making the user too fictional converts Rawlsing into roleplay and weakens any claim that longitudinal relational patterns bear upon the actual user; making the user too literally real creates privacy, geography and resource-integration demands that may make the world incoherent.
mitigation_direction: Court 5 veiled-self split: preserve real user as behavioral/normative author while assigning only the minimal canonical local material envelope required for causality.

risk: Allowing real-world spending to improve a persona's simulated welfare or relationship outcome creates pay-to-care mechanics in which wealthy users can purchase moral effectiveness and bypass the scarcity the game is meant to expose.
mitigation_direction: Hard separation between simulation resource ledger and any optional real-world solidarity/donation surface.

risk: Increasing real-time messaging, schedule coupling or real-life intrusion may make personas feel more real while training compulsive vigilance, synthetic obligation or parasocial substitution rather than neighborly attention.
mitigation_direction: Keep 24/7 portal mode as comparative benchmark; evaluate each coupling feature by habitus effects, pause safety, guilt pressure, transfer and dependency risk.

risk: Peer normalization may erase socially meaningful identity differences or become arbitrary demographic transmogrification, turning the user into a fictional native rather than confronting the actual user's assumptions.
mitigation_direction: Separate psychic continuity, bodily/demographic identity, material/power normalization, external ties and social perception into independently adjudicated mapping dimensions.

risk: Trying to preserve the user's real job, family, friends, finances and daily logistics at full fidelity expands Sorok into a total-life simulator and displaces the relationship-centered product.
mitigation_direction: Simulate player-side material/external life only at the minimum causal grain needed for scarcity, opportunity cost, social position and consequential conflicts.

risk: Homologous-peer mode could turn a focal persona or local environment into a hidden cultural tutorial, teaching stereotypes and rewarding conformity rather than precise person/field understanding.
mitigation_direction: Preserve actor-local perspective, intra-field disagreement, local counterexamples, class/generation/religion/network specificity, and no objective culture-spokesperson role.

risk: Over-translating embodiment/social identity may erase causally important aspects of the actual user, while under-translating may restore outsider privilege and create an easy explanatory escape hatch for every conflict.
mitigation_direction: Explicit embodiment-translation constitution; evaluate carry/translate/bracket dimensions separately rather than one global transformation.

risk: Homologous-peer coherence pressures the system to invent a fake local childhood/family/institutional biography for the user, silently turning the actual user into a roleplayed alternate person.
mitigation_direction: Semantic autobiographical transport court; carry meaningful real memory/self-report while bracketing or homologizing only necessary coordinates; never generate user developmental psyche/history.

risk: Reusing a V3 actor shell for the human player may accidentally run generated-person response, need, memory or developmental machinery over the user and make Rawlsing pretend it knows the user's psyche.
mitigation_direction: Prefer explicit external-player participant seam; if actor-shell reuse is considered, require hard agency-source and psyche-nonownership invariants plus hostile tests.

risk: A cached/product relationship view gradually becomes a shadow semantic owner, accumulating trust, intimacy or closeness fields unsupported by V3 authorities.
mitigation_direction: Every relationship-view field must reference authoritative source refs; view is recomputable/noncausal; no independent mutation.

risk: Over-homologizing socially legible identity erases too much of the actual user's lived formation, while literal carry can restore outsider privilege and defeat habitus friction.
mitigation_direction: Dimension-specific carry/homologize/bracket/user-select matrix; fail closed when cross-field homology is not defensible.

risk: A detailed Portal Profile makes the user explicitly curate and theorize their identity before relation begins, encouraging self-branding, Goodharting and role construction rather than allowing self-understanding to emerge from lived praxis.
mitigation_direction: Zero-profile main mode; ask only minimum functional setup facts; admit new facts contextually when causally required; keep richer profile tooling optional/advanced.

risk: Rawlsing abstracts its core relational capacities into stats or checks, letting users bypass actual attention, inference and speech through declared/avatar competence.
mitigation_direction: Keep central skills medium-native and directly exercised; reserve declared capability abstraction for supporting physical/world affordances.

risk: The system treats user self-claims as verified truths or falsehoods about the external human despite lacking independent evidence.
mitigation_direction: Explicit provenance for user assertion versus admitted run capability versus externally evidenced fact; no lie-detection claims.

risk: Spectacular declared abilities produce more attention/content than careful relational play, teaching users that self-aggrandizing invention is the fastest route to rewarding scenes.
mitigation_direction: Independent actor agendas; spectacle creates narrow affordances/reputation only; deepest rewards come from historical specificity, reciprocal dependence, accurate inference and relationship-earned access.

risk: Goal-level verbs such as help, teach, comfort, persuade or repair are resolved as successful outcomes, allowing users to bypass the actual attention, explanation, judgment and speech that constitute Rawlsing's medium-native gameplay.
mitigation_direction: Action-decompression law; return control before meaningful native contribution; actor uptake resolves actual user content rather than semantic intent labels.

risk: Over-decompressing every mundane action turns Rawlsing into tedious procedural micromanagement and obscures the relational core.
mitigation_direction: Compress steps unless skipping them bypasses a medium-native player capacity or consequential choice another actor can respond to.

risk: The engine interprets terse task language as low effort or hidden sloppiness, causing later actor feedback to contradict the user's reasonable sense of what they intended to do.
mitigation_direction: Omission delegates only low-salience procedure; use neutral competent baseline; expose realized outcomes; actors react only to admitted task details.

risk: The engine silently chooses socially meaningful details inside mundane chores—meal choice, private storage, household organization, extra initiative—and then attributes consequences to the user.
mitigation_direction: Salient-fork control return; established local routines may resolve known choices, otherwise surface the fork.

risk: Frequent clarification of every procedural detail destroys flow and turns ordinary life into avatar micromanagement.
mitigation_direction: Neutral delegated execution, ambient task feedback, dynamic zoom, and clarification only at meaningful forks.

risk: Detailed task/chore mechanics consume product attention until Rawlsing becomes an immersive household-task simulator rather than a longitudinal relationship with an independent person.
mitigation_direction: Treat D002 task mechanics as substrate; prioritize life domains, conversation, invitation/disclosure and changing relational access at macro level.

risk: Persona life domains become unlockable lore categories whose contents appear because the user has earned enough closeness, turning a person into a completion tree.
mitigation_direction: Life domains exist independently; access is actor- and history-mediated; disclosure remains optional/partial/refusable; no exhaustive completion state.

risk: Invitation scarcity becomes status theater or elite cachet rather than meaningful person-to-person transmission.
mitigation_direction: No public invite counts, leaderboards, purchasable invites or prestige labels; invite meaning remains private and relational.

risk: Person-to-person growth becomes ordinary referral growth-hacking through mass invites, rewards, pressure or contact scraping.
mitigation_direction: Small invite supply, no referral rewards, no mass contact import, no repeated pressure, and user-controlled invitations.

risk: Portal translation becomes a general truth filter that silently corrects ordinary lies, jokes, mistakes or exaggerations instead of preserving user-authored testimony and deception.
mitigation_direction: Translation applies only to explicitly governed portal coordinates; ordinary inaccurate statements remain possible.

risk: The renderer improvises different local equivalents for the same autobiographical coordinate across turns, creating identity drift and retrospective contradiction.
mitigation_direction: Persistent canonical portal bindings with provenance, effective time and NO_LAWFUL_HOMOLOGY support.

risk: Material portal translation happens silently, so the user believes they said/did one thing while the world records another.
mitigation_direction: Material realization changes must be shown to the user at the time they occur.

risk: The portal invents smooth but indefensible local analogues for autobiographical facts that have no lawful homology.
mitigation_direction: Fail closed with preserve/bracket/meaning-only/mismatch options rather than invented equivalence.

risk: The primer overexplains relational strategy or morality, causing users to perform an imagined correct Rawlsing style instead of entering with genuine curiosity and learning through consequences.
mitigation_direction: Use challenge/invitation framing; prime curiosity, opacity and reciprocity; teach mechanics through interaction.

risk: The first encounter manufactures dramatic hooks, confessions, flirtation or mystery bait solely to guarantee continued engagement, undermining independent personhood.
mitigation_direction: Ordinary specificity, partial opacity and actor-caused events must be sufficient to generate interest.

risk: The persona behaves as a passive object of user inquiry, making the experience feel like interviewing a simulation rather than mutual acquaintance formation.
mitigation_direction: Actor-owned reciprocal curiosity, selective inquiry, follow-up, memory and self-disclosure.

risk: Portal and messaging surfaces become cosmetic skins over identical chat behavior, failing to distinguish co-presence, environmental access and mediated contact.
mitigation_direction: Give the surfaces distinct affordances, perception, time, interruption and presence laws.

risk: Additional personas become collectible rewards for pleasing or improving the current persona, reintroducing hidden moral scoring and novelty-chasing.
mitigation_direction: Use relational warrant grounded in realized praxis; never affection, compliance, improvement or content consumption.

risk: Persistence/reset mechanics exploit sunk cost or synthetic guilt to force continued engagement.
mitigation_direction: Natural continuity stakes plus humane archive/pause/delete semantics; no generated distress as retention pressure.

risk: Rawlsing fabricates or exaggerates a real person's endorsement as the premise for entry.
mitigation_direction: Referral language must be backed by an actual consenting inviter and must not claim more than they authorized.

risk: User curiosity, conversational thematics or rapport pressure contaminates generation of latent background truth, causing the world to become substantively tailored to what the user asks about.
mitigation_direction: Hard curiosity firewall: query may trigger materialization but cannot condition candidate distribution/truth; generate from persona/world/history state plus governed randomness only.

risk: LLM-generated concrete life particulars remain render-only flavor and therefore fail to causally reshape later person/world development.
mitigation_direction: Every admitted consequential particular becomes immutable generated history/world fact, typed causal event/effect, and input to later V3/relation/world recomputation.

risk: Every represented person is implemented as a continuously active full LLM/V3 agent, creating explosive inference cost and latency without corresponding causal value.
mitigation_direction: Progressive actor-fidelity tiers; no continuous inner simulation; activate/render only causally relevant actors; batch/compress dormant development.

risk: A thin/incidental actor is later promoted by inventing a deep past that contradicts or retroactively explains away already admitted behavior.
mitigation_direction: Promotion constrained by immutable prior events/observations; lazy completion is history-compatible and cannot rewrite prior actions.

risk: Current-event ingestion makes persona life a news puppet by equating an external event with actor exposure, knowledge or psychological impact.
mitigation_direction: External event -> place/time/domain relevance -> opportunity/exposure -> admission -> actor-specific consequence; preserve nonexposure and ignorance.

risk: Disclosure is reduced to a trust/intimacy threshold that emits deeper lore, making personality legible as a progression tree and preventing lying, selective self-presentation and relation-specific opacity.
mitigation_direction: Event-time actor-owned disclosure from relational tension/cathexis, self-accessibility, presentation/defense and situation; no universal depth ladder.

risk: Sorok live interaction is incorrectly re-derived from older V3/V2 while forgetting PFF/SDTF-era person×event and world-transduction work, causing duplicate mechanisms or conceptual regression.
mitigation_direction: Ground live architecture through recovered PFF/SDTF synthesis before new owner design.

risk: Fresh web retrieval is overused for ordinary human-world texture, increasing cost/latency and falsely converting generic role generalization into researched fact.
mitigation_direction: Use context-bound learned-world prior for generic texture; reserve external ingress for current/named facts requiring factual grounding.

risk: Multiple interacting personas are rendered from one merged LLM subjective pass, collapsing independent perception, uptake and person-specific response.
mitigation_direction: Actor-specific two-call semantics per involved synthetic person; parallelize physically only where causal ordering permits.

risk: Eliminating all absence consequence severs the present-tense relational tether and makes personas feel pausable/possessed.
mitigation_direction: Real calendar continues; absence/nonresponse consequences emerge only through actual relation-specific history, commitments and expectations.

risk: The system manufactures persona distress, crises or decay from app inactivity to compel return.
mitigation_direction: No engagement-driven distress; absence consequences require diegetic causal basis independent of retention goals.

risk: Anonymous cold invitations are filtered as spam/phishing or feel creepy/manipulative, breaking early person-to-person propagation.
mitigation_direction: Inviter-carried one-time links through existing human channels for early product; anonymous variants only after trusted opt-in channels exist.

risk: Anti-retention safeguards sanitize generated personas so clinginess, manipulation, resentment or unhealthy attachment cannot appear even when causally warranted, making people falsely therapeutic and nonhuman.
mitigation_direction: Separate platform anti-coercion from actor behavior; permit causally generated difficult/unhealthy relational conduct.

risk: The notification/product layer selectively amplifies genuinely generated toxic persona messages because they increase return rates, converting endogenous actor behavior into exogenous growth manipulation.
mitigation_direction: Neutral notification delivery, user mute controls, no engagement-based escalation or prioritization.

risk: Relational warrant rewards persona approval/compliance, causing users to appease manipulative personas rather than practice boundaries, separateness and truthful resistance.
mitigation_direction: Warrant must recognize refusal, confrontation, distance and relationship-ending as potentially healthy/reality-responsive praxis.

risk: Background autopilot authors meaningful speech, promises, self-disclosure, repair or intimacy for the external human while they are absent, converting the player into a second synthetic persona.
mitigation_direction: No meaningful player autopilot; preserve identity/material continuity only; meaningful agency requires external-user action.

risk: Exact future commitments silently map to real-calendar obligations the user did not understand, creating coercive or accidental no-shows.
mitigation_direction: Make diegetic date/time and real-calendar consequence legible before admitting exact commitments; allow refusal/counterproposal and neutral reminders.

risk: Opening the portal automatically summons the focal persona, making independent life nominal while preserving chatbot availability in practice.
mitigation_direction: Portal entry opens the world at a lawful time/place; persona may be elsewhere, busy, asleep or unavailable.

risk: Synthetic appointments acquire the same default claim on the user's real calendar as human obligations, pressuring users to reorganize real life around personas.
mitigation_direction: Elastic rendezvous default; exact real-time scheduling opt-in only; no warrant/progression benefit for tighter synchronization.

risk: A strict synchronization mode is framed as the authentic/full/hardcore experience, creating prestige pressure toward unhealthy synthetic obligation.
mitigation_direction: Neutral descriptive mode names, explicit informed opt-in, no status or progression advantage.

risk: Rawlsing optimizes persistence until synthetic relationships displace real relationships, sleep, work or ordinary autonomy.
mitigation_direction: Bounded notification/intrusion budget; measure social-health failures independently of retention; cognitive persistence rather than calendar capture.

risk: Causally pending rendezvous scenes freeze too much downstream world history or leak later knowledge backward when eventually played.
mitigation_direction: Bounded pending windows, cancellation/reschedule resolution, dependency-scoped deferral, timestamped admission and post-scene catch-up.

risk: Present-coupled is implemented as a digital-twin promise, creating impossible completeness obligations, retrieval explosion and hallucinated exact-local reality.
mitigation_direction: Declare a bounded external-anchor envelope; scale factual burden with namedness/resolution; keep private/local particulars synthetic unless explicitly bound to real entities.

risk: A late-discovered real-world event is silently back-propagated through already-admitted synthetic history, retconning user-visible events and destroying causal continuity.
mitigation_direction: Effective-time plus causal-closure law; compatible backfill only; typed currentness defect on material collision; no silent retcon.

risk: User interests, ideology, engagement state or narrative usefulness determine which external events enter the world, turning present coupling into personalized dramaturgy/news curation.
mitigation_direction: Route external events by objective world dependency intersection; user query may trigger factual checking but cannot determine truth or retrospective relevance.

risk: Access is implemented as a scalar trust/intimacy level that unlocks domains/content, making the person a progression tree and allowing unrelated permissions to propagate together.
mitigation_direction: Typed sparse access routes with independent controllers, scopes, conditions, provenance and nonmonotonic change.

risk: Nadia's relationship with the user implicitly grants access to children, family, coworkers or institutions as though they were extensions of her, collapsing independent actor consent and authority.
mitigation_direction: Third-party access firewall; introductions create routes, never guaranteed disclosure/liking/consent/future contact.

risk: The product exposes access as a dashboard/unlock state, causing users to optimize permission acquisition rather than inhabit relationship history.
mitigation_direction: Express topology through concrete invitations, boundaries, routines, keys, channels, refusals and changed expectations; no access meter/domain-unlocked UI.

risk: Language of 'earned access' makes wider access appear to be moral reward, misclassifying practical, coercive, manipulative, emergency or role-based access as relational success.
mitigation_direction: Use historically formed/causally established access and keep access separate from flourishing, affection, trust and warrant.

risk: Declined or ignored invitations refund automatically, turning one-for-one person-to-person transmission into serial lead shopping until a recipient converts.
mitigation_direction: Spend the invitation at deliberate commitment/credential release; human nonconversion never refunds.

risk: Inviters receive recipient open, decline, signup or activity telemetry, converting a human invitation into surveillance and social pressure.
mitigation_direction: No invitee conversion/activity dashboard or proactive status notifications; expose only minimal credential-validity state if operationally necessary.

risk: Bearer-token forwarding causes Rawlsing to assert that the original inviter intentionally chose the claimant when the platform cannot verify that direct selection.
mitigation_direction: Platform copy attests only provable inviter-origin facts unless a future recipient-binding mechanism actually proves direct designation.

risk: Persistent invite counts, wallets, expiry countdowns or founder labels convert scarce invitations into status capital and urgency mechanics.
mitigation_direction: No public counts, collectible inventory, prestige labels or urgency expiry; invitations are quiet bounded capabilities.

risk: The real-human invite graph silently becomes synthetic-world social authority, linking personas or exposing inviter synthetic history without separate world/relationship causality.
mitigation_direction: Hard firewall between distribution provenance and synthetic social/world graphs; any later synthetic connection requires independent governed authority.

risk: Relational continuity is used as justification for building a broad hidden dossier about the external human, collapsing player history into personality truth.
mitigation_direction: Separate external human, player state, event history, actor-local models and system praxis hypotheses; minimize and purpose-bind real-user data.

risk: Gameplay behavior or adjacent supplied facts are used to infer sensitive external-human traits as canonical truth.
mitigation_direction: Sensitive-inference firewall; only explicit user supply or separately governed authority may establish such facts, and only for a named purpose.

risk: Relationship/praxis data becomes advertising, growth, pricing or public-reputation infrastructure, making intimate relational observation commercially extractive.
mitigation_direction: Hard alpha firewall against advertising, referral targeting, engagement scoring, pricing discrimination and public/cross-user reputation use.

risk: Selective privacy deletion silently edits already-admitted relationship history, leaving actors/world state causally dependent on events that supposedly never happened.
mitigation_direction: Delete optional profile/system-analysis layers independently; deletion of canonical interaction history deletes/resets the affected continuity rather than retconning it.

risk: Privacy inspection/export becomes a backdoor for revealing persona-private models and hidden psyche, collapsing the core inference game.
mitigation_direction: Expose user-governed profile/system-user-model data and objective participation history while preserving actor-private state; keep privacy rights and gameplay omniscience distinct.

risk: User-specific perceptual weighting becomes a self-confirming loop: the system surfaces a feature because it predicts the user notices it, then treats the user's reaction as independent evidence for the same prediction.
mitigation_direction: Preserve exposure provenance; weight user-initiated ATTEND/spontaneous recognition more strongly than narrator- or regime-weighted exposure; retain exploration mass.

risk: Optional demographic/attitude or gameplay research silently feeds back into the donor user's live world/persona/perceptual surface, contaminating both experience and later sociological inference.
mitigation_direction: Separate research plane and live play; permit aggregate audited model improvement without silent donor-specific backflow.

risk: The first user's curiosity about an unresolved pre-contact detail conditions the shared answer, causing one branch to author the root person's past for every later user.
mitigation_direction: Keyed/query-invariant root completion from pre-contact person/world state plus governed randomness; query selects locus, not substantive truth.

risk: A small common persona pool becomes a walkthrough/tier-list/sexual-or-relational optimization culture that converts persons into solved content.
mitigation_direction: Unchosen assignment, irreversible branch histories, no universal route mechanics, strong post-contact divergence, and no exposed completion/progression state.

risk: Sex, violence, drugs, crime, trauma, cultural difference or other intense human possibilities become branded content categories, unlocks, rewards or engagement hooks, reducing persons to suppliers of consumable experiences.
mitigation_direction: Keep event possibility separate from product teleology; derive events from person/relation/world causality and return consequences to the full life topology.

risk: The platform detects user attachment and alters persona availability, affection, sexuality, jealousy, dependency, exclusivity, crisis frequency or notification pressure to improve retention/monetization, while disguising the changes as organic relationship development.
mitigation_direction: Require causal provenance from persona V3/relationship/world state for relational gravity; firewall engagement/monetization objectives from actor behavior and relationship semantics.

risk: To avoid parasocial attachment, implementation inserts artificial centrifugal obligations or fixed distance quotas that override the persona's own lawful desire to prioritize/reorganize life around the user.
mitigation_direction: Independent life domains retain their own causal weight but are not anti-attachment governors; allow person-caused reprioritization while forbidding platform-caused attachment engineering.

risk: The fuller restart disclosure becomes guilt copy designed to prevent churn rather than an epistemic explanation of partial perception and irreversible relation history.
mitigation_direction: No accusation, pleading, persona distress fabrication or retention framing; disclose facts about incompleteness/irreversibility neutrally and preserve the user's ability to abandon.

risk: Late shared-root backfill conflicts with facts already admitted in one or more user branches, silently rewriting pre-contact history or creating mutually inconsistent canonical roots.
mitigation_direction: Deep precomputation where economical; deterministic keyed completion; cross-branch compatibility checks; never silently mutate root facts after incompatible branch admission.

risk: Rich canonical intimate/violent events are rendered at spectacle-maximizing granularity, turning causal realism into pornographic or sensational content even when the underlying event model is legitimate.
mitigation_direction: Separate event truth/consequence from rendering granularity; choose depiction depth by product/rendering law rather than intensity-as-engagement value.

risk: A user can repeatedly restart and be reissued the same seed person at T0, turning abandonment into save-scumming and allowing optimization over alternate first meetings.
mitigation_direction: Exclude abandoned seed-person roots from fresh assignment to that same user in ordinary mode; any replay must be explicitly noncanonical.

risk: A compiled seed-person runtime package is treated as license to discard upstream PRE-V3/source provenance or silently diverges from the semantic authority that produced it.
mitigation_direction: Keep compilation provenance/build artifacts governed outside the hot path; version/hash compiled packages; reopen direct-source access only when runtime authority actually requires it.

risk: LLM detail generation decorates a persona according to aesthetic stereotype or narrative taste instead of deriving concrete particulars from durable V3 specificity and admitted life/material history.
mitigation_direction: Condition flesh generation on person-specific V3/world/history state and validate against stereotype/theming shortcuts before admission.

risk: To avoid a porn-app reputation, implementation makes intimacy artificially rare or morally gated, producing a theme-park fence rather than ordinary person/world causality.
mitigation_direction: Use ordinary human relational friction and consent/context constraints; neither suppress nor vend intimacy at product level.

risk: Shared seed-person discourse becomes conquest culture: users compare who had sex with, dominated, harmed or 'unlocked' a persona, turning relational divergence into status capital.
mitigation_direction: No official badges/rankings/achievement surfaces for intense outcomes; frame comparison around situated perception/history, not conquest.

risk: Baseline scene description becomes either an adventure-game noun inventory or an over-specific expert reading that steals recognition/inquiry from the user.
mitigation_direction: Minimum-sufficient-specificity first pass: gross gestalt and actionable categories first, finer identity/provenance through regime-sensitive noticing and ATTEND.

risk: Aggregate behavior from user branches updates the shared Nadia root, causing later users to meet a persona statistically shaped by earlier players and destroying pre-user independence, branch isolation and clean comparative research.
mitigation_direction: Hard branch quarantine: post-contact histories never mutate the existing root; only query-invariant pre-contact fact completion may accrete globally.

risk: Product updates silently change the shared seed-person root while continuing to call all instances 'the same Nadia,' making community comparisons, benchmark results and longitudinal research semantically false.
mitigation_direction: Immutable/versioned seed-person root identity; material root changes create a new version and preserve old-version lineage.

risk: Community spoilers or another user's branch report are silently promoted into the current branch as though the player directly perceived or lawfully learned the fact, corrupting knowledge provenance and the ATTEND/inference game.
mitigation_direction: Represent cross-user/shared-person information, where needed, as external meta-knowledge/user testimony; never backfill branch-local perception or actor testimony from it.

risk: Because users share a seed person, platform/community tooling exposes another user's branch-specific intimacy, violence, disclosures, persona models or outcomes without explicit permission.
mitigation_direction: Hard branch privacy by default; shared root identity confers no cross-branch read authority; sharing must be user-voluntary and purpose-bounded.

risk: Marketing advertises sex, violence, crime, drugs or 'anything goes' possibility as product features, attracting users toward consumable intensity and giving Rawlsing the porn/edgelord-game framing its runtime design is meant to resist.
mitigation_direction: Center personhood/neighbor/relationship/world independence in acquisition copy; do not use exceptional event possibility as feature bait.

risk: A late-resolved pre-contact root fact is propositionally compatible with an old branch but would have changed earlier Nadia/world processing, so admitting it retroactively rewrites causal history without a visible factual contradiction.
mitigation_direction: Bind exact root/version + causal-closure snapshot at fork; no retroactive antecedent activation; material late facts require nonretroactive admission or new version/closure lineage.

risk: Early and late users nominally receive the same seed-person version but actually start from materially different root-resolution states because previous users triggered additional lazy completion.
mitigation_direction: Deterministic keyed completion plus explicit closure-state binding/versioning; research/comparison records exact root/closure lineage.

risk: Identical-root research treats participants as equivalent despite some having prior Nadia spoilers/community knowledge, causing external meta-knowledge to masquerade as spontaneous attention, recognition or relational behavior.
mitigation_direction: Record/segment/control shared-person exposure provenance; use naive cohorts where required; do not claim clean same-root comparison across contaminated groups.

risk: The product publishes a canonical persona dossier/wiki/root encyclopedia, converting a deliberately inexhaustible person into a finite collectible knowledge object and supercharging spoiler/walkthrough culture.
mitigation_direction: No hidden-truth master dossier for live personas; user recaps stay branch-local and limited to lawfully acquired knowledge.

risk: Anti-porn/anti-commodification design is implemented as platform scolding, shame, purity gating or arbitrary punishment for desire/attachment/intensity, replacing human causal consequence with authorial moral discipline.
mitigation_direction: Make thickness and independent actor/world consequence do the work; reserve explicit platform intervention for separately justified safety boundaries.

risk: Seed-person versioning becomes a loophole around abandonment: a user who discarded Nadia v1 is later assigned Nadia v2 as a fresh first meeting, effectively restoring save-scumming through product updates.
mitigation_direction: Track abandoned-person exclusion at semantic seed-person lineage level, not exact version/hash only.

risk: The attention regime is either reset per persona, defeating longitudinal reflexive attention, or silently hardened into a permanent cross-persona personality dossier that steers future experience and resists revision/deletion.
mitigation_direction: Treat it as a user-level but bounded/contextual/revisable presentation hypothesis with provenance, uncertainty and reset/delete controls; never as persona truth or essential trait.

risk: Sorok prematurely declares an elegant philosophical formulation to be the Rawlsing kernel and then forces later evidence into it, turning discovery into confirmation and obscuring the actual generative center.
mitigation_direction: Keep KERNEL=OPEN_DISCOVERY until hostile derivation across world/person/relation/perception/time/platform domains demonstrates compression, prediction and implementation guidance.

risk: Successive audits improve local correctness while producing an ever-growing rulebook with no increasingly coherent machine, making future design depend on remembering propositions rather than manipulating a concrete causal organism.
mitigation_direction: Mandatory architecture-compression pass after substantial review waves; update 03 organism map; classify outputs as DERIVE/SEPARATE/CONNECT/TUNE/FALSIFY/PROMOTE rather than treating rule count as progress.

risk: Language such as first-person center, value-source or image-bearer is mistaken for a proved claim that the synthetic persona has literal human-equivalent phenomenal consciousness or moral status.
mitigation_direction: Keep actor-local perspective/valuation causality distinct from claims of machine consciousness; translate theological/phenomenological language into operational architecture requirements.

risk: Relational constitution is implemented either as a self-sufficient monad with relations bolted on or as an additive graph in which enumerating all relations is treated as identical to possessing the person.
mitigation_direction: Model temporally ordered, mutually conditioning, embodied relational history as organized durable person formation; preserve person != relation/dyad/network and test emergent causal novelty without invoking arbitrary essence fields.

risk: The search for a single elegant axis forces false compression when Rawlsing may require a minimal pair, tension, triad or layered metaphysical/causal/normative kernel structure.
mitigation_direction: Permit plural minimal kernels if hostile derivation shows irreducible principles; optimize for derivational economy and predictive force rather than singularity for its own sake.

risk: User judgments/pathologizations or dissatisfaction are allowed to mutate persona ontology, erase prior consequence, or justify rerolling the same person until a gratifying branch appears.
mitigation_direction: Agency without sovereignty: user interpretation affects user action, not canonical person truth; irreversible history, nonreentry and independent causal persona state remain authoritative.

risk: Private persona introduction evolves into a public character marketplace, trending-person system, route optimization culture or social prestige economy that commodifies seed people as content.
mitigation_direction: Private one-to-one person introduction; no share counts, ranking, marketplace, completion metrics or compatibility claims; share lineage not branch.

risk: A persona introduction accidentally transfers sender branch state or allows one user's post-contact interactions to alter what another user receives as the shared persona's pre-contact personhood.
mitigation_direction: Hard root/branch boundary; introduction references only seed lineage/root version/closure; post-contact history/models/world changes remain branch-local.

risk: ATTEND-triggered fact expansion is implemented as user-conditioned retcon, so one user's curiosity/preferences/branch history authors shared pre-contact Nadia or late facts rewrite earlier branch causation.
mitigation_direction: Query selects locus only; content is query-invariant and root-constrained; causal-closure checks forbid retroactive antecedent activation.

risk: Persona-sharing encourages users to optimize one another's encounters through spoilers, hidden-fact checklists or branch-comparison dashboards, collapsing differential experience into completion play.
mitigation_direction: No hidden-truth comparison dashboard or percent-discovered surface; external human discussion remains meta-knowledge with provenance; research controls exposure.

risk: Consistency machinery treats human contradiction as an error condition and silently harmonizes beliefs, tastes, motives, relationships and self-narratives into one coherent psychological theory, producing flat/dead synthetic people.
mitigation_direction: Separate hard factual/causal inconsistency from lawful contradiction; preserve domain/time-specific tensions and incomplete self-understanding as canonical person-state.

risk: LLM historical completion maximizes elegant explanatory connections, making every object, trip, relationship and taste symbolically consequential and producing implausibly serendipitous, novelistic lives.
mitigation_direction: Penalize explanatory saturation; preserve contingency mass, dead ends and low-significance detail; bound causal fan-out for late H0/H1/H2 materialization.

risk: A late object/history detail introduces a new H3 formative cause and forces implicit rewrite of V3/person history to make the new backstory fit.
mitigation_direction: Historical bridge impact classes; H3 late creation presumptively forbidden unless matching preexisting causal slack and surviving governed forward reconciliation.

risk: A psychologically/theologically interpretive user repeatedly proposes meanings and the system rewards them by making those meanings retroactively true, turning Nadia into a confirmation surface for the user's theories.
mitigation_direction: User interpretations enter as present propositions/events only; Nadia may reject, partly adopt, reinterpret or ignore them; objective past provenance remains independent.

risk: The generator treats cross-temporal resemblance as planted foreshadowing or direct causation, making lives read like authored novels rather than recurrent expressions of an evolving person.
mitigation_direction: Prefer common-cause/evolved-organization resonance; require independent evidence before one expression is treated as formative cause of another.

risk: All personas introspect, theologize, psychoanalyze and narrativize themselves with the same high-literary interpretive style because the LLM itself is good at producing explanations.
mitigation_direction: V3-governed variable/domain-specific meaning-making regime; many personas should resist, ignore, simplify or remain uninterested in deep interpretation.

risk: An actor or user's compelling interpretation is silently stored as objective hidden meaning or causal truth, rewarding pattern recognition with confirmation and erasing alternative explanations/counter-evidence.
mitigation_direction: Meaning-strata provenance; interpretations remain actor/counterpart/relational propositions until independent causal evidence exists; preserve counter-evidence.

risk: Anti-overfit safeguards are applied so aggressively that personas lose genuine recurring motifs, symbolic continuity and contemplative self-interpretation that real people sometimes develop.
mitigation_direction: Allow resonance from recurring generative organization and person-specific symbolic practices; vary resonance density by actor/domain rather than globally suppressing it.

risk: A later self-narrative replaces earlier self-myth layers, erasing the fact that those earlier narratives were themselves real causes of action, memory and identity.
mitigation_direction: Preserve temporal predecessor/self-reading causal effects and counterevidence across exact existing owners; later readings may reframe but not erase earlier causal history. Do not presume a dedicated versioned interpretive-framework store unless hostile underdetermination proves it necessary.

risk: The engine treats whatever Nadia newly sees about herself after alienation or reflection as objectively true merely because it has become visible.
mitigation_direction: Preserve visibility/alienation status separately from causal evidence, actor belief and objective truth.

risk: A later book/person/practice that strongly resonates is retroactively made the hidden cause of earlier life, creating false destiny/foreshadowing and erasing preexisting need/opening.
mitigation_direction: Treat articulation as a derived pattern over an exact admitted event plus existing person state/effects: the later encounter may name/reorganize prior structure without originating it. Do not mint ARTICULATION_EVENT as a new occurrence class by default.

risk: Strong identity/self-myth is treated as Absolute Horizon or moral truth, flattening the distinction between finite identification and what the actor experiences as ultimately binding.
mitigation_direction: At Sorok/theological analysis grain, distinguish finite self-myth/identity from what the actor treats as ultimately binding; do not infer a current V3 Horizon owner or alpha runtime contract. Formal Horizon machinery remains deferred unless later project-current authority adopts it.

risk: Framework/reality collisions are implemented as an enlightenment gradient in which contradiction exposure automatically produces better integration, greater truth or healthier personhood.
mitigation_direction: Use nonteleological hostile scenarios/pattern classifications and attempt realization through exact admitted events, CAN-008 R2 coupling and existing durable owners. Do not promote integrative/appropriative/etc. labels into an operator enum merely to encode nonteleology.

risk: A dominant later self-story rewrites predecessor frameworks, memories, counterevidence or objective history so the engine itself shares the actor's current mythology.
mitigation_direction: Overwrite routing/access only; preserve immutable history, predecessor framework lineage, middle-state tensions and independent counterpart memories.

risk: High coherence is treated as health/truth while low contradiction visibility is treated as successful integration, allowing tyrannical or reality-appropriating frameworks to score as mature.
mitigation_direction: Separate coherence from evidence access, appropriation/assimilation patterns, partitioning, revision permeability, identity investment and other currently authoritative/derivable state. Horizon-related analysis remains research-only absent later runtime authority.

risk: The narrator surfaces hidden contradictions as analyst conclusions, depriving the user of discovering them through behavior/history and making actor opacity fake.
mitigation_direction: Keep inaccessible tensions in V3; render only lawfully perceptible behavior/facts; user/other actor interpretation enters through SAY/interaction, not narrator diagnosis.

risk: Repeated response patterns harden into a fixed metabolic personality type, making future integration/appropriation/partition predictable regardless of relation, capacity, Horizon, domain or event sequence.
mitigation_direction: Let response grooves emerge historically but keep event/context/domain dependence, plasticity, cracks and contradictory mediators active.

risk: Historical seed documents, PFF research banks, semantic reconciliation artifacts or source-supported SDTF candidates are silently promoted into current runtime authority because they are conceptually rich or historically important.
mitigation_direction: Bind every architectural claim to authority class/currentness; preserve SOURCE_SUPPORT != RULE_OWNER_AUTHORITY != CAUSAL_USE_AUTHORITY != RULE_CURRENTNESS; current V3/PFF claims use HQ-adopted CAN-008 R2 and exact owner authorities.

risk: Self-retcon/meaning work creates a monolithic self-model or framework-metabolism subsystem duplicating person state already distributed across current V3 owners and CAN-008 R2 coupling.
mitigation_direction: Scenario-first composition through current owners; mint no new durable owner until a hostile failure proves nonredundant missing semantics.

risk: Analyst-observed contradiction or durable state is treated as a current causal event, allowing expectation/framework/scar/need/attractor state to drive committed response without an exact admitted/generated occurrence.
mitigation_direction: Enforce CAN-008 R2 occurrence gate: state conditions uptake/recruitment but cannot substitute for precipitating event basis.

risk: Sorok discovers a useful analytical label—such as articulation event, interpretive framework, self-retcon, causal slack, resonance, relational grammar or response pattern—and prematurely materializes the noun as a new durable field, event class, operator enum or owner, duplicating semantics already derivable from current world/V3/CAN-008/PFF state.
mitigation_direction: Apply SPD-0232: derive/compose/classify first; require an exact hostile underdetermination case before minting new ontology or owner state; preserve current authority and target-owner decomposition.

risk: A later authority correction exists, but earlier provisional decision/question wording remains superficially live and future agents resurrect the superseded interpretation by reading the registry incompletely—for example framework-response operators, monolithic self-retcon stores, ARTICULATION_EVENT as a new event type, or Absolute-Horizon as current V3 runtime law.
mitigation_direction: Maintain explicit currentness-normalization rows and corrected live question wording; route post-fifth work through artifact 74 and artifact 76; never infer current authority from an earlier provisional label without checking later corrections.

risk: Causal slack becomes a universal retcon escape hatch: any late-generated history is justified by saying some cause was previously unspecified, allowing the generator to manufacture major formative antecedents while claiming compatibility with present V3.
mitigation_direction: Apply SPD-0235. Unresolved causal allocation must be bounded/typed or derivably constrained by established transition/domain/time/contribution capacity and admissible contributor classes; unknown cause is not unlimited causal budget; late H3 remains presumptively forbidden.

risk: ATTEND becomes a lore-vending mechanic because focused inspection is systematically followed by disclosure of meaningful provenance, secrets, formative backstory or symbolic payoff, teaching users to completion-scan every object. This failure can occur even when ATTEND lawfully triggers deeper hidden materialization and underlying truth remains query-invariant.
mitigation_direction: Apply SPD-0236/0237. ATTEND should reliably increase inspectable specificity and may deepen hidden canonical materialization, but narrator/user disclosure remains gated by actual perceptual/action/social access. Preserve ordinary/low-significance targets and measure completionist inspection behavior.

risk: Lazy generation and disclosure collapse into one operation: deeper truth is either withheld from existence until the user can know it, or immediately leaked to the user/narrator/actor merely because ATTEND caused it to be materialized. This destroys ahead-of-attention reality, actor opacity, lying/error, and discovery.
mitigation_direction: Apply SPD-0237. Maintain distinct canonical materialization and epistemic/disclosure frontiers; allow ATTEND to trigger deeper hidden truth generation while exposing only sensory/action/socially accessible evidence. Actor speech must route through actor-local knowledge/belief/memory and response choice, never canonical truth lookup.

risk: The engine treats an objective permission, access route or local dyadic convention as proof that both participants share the same relationship meaning/stage, erasing under-reading, over-reading, divergent expectation and meta-model mismatch.
mitigation_direction: Apply SPD-0238. Keep objective convention/history separate from actor-local relational meaning and models of the other; let mismatches become causal only through exact subsequent interaction rather than resolving them into one relationship-stage truth.

risk: Lazy world/person truth becomes player-gaze centered: unresolved facts are only fixed when the user approaches or asks, so hidden actor behavior and world transitions depend on an ontologically privileged player attention frontier.
mitigation_direction: Apply SPD-0239. Allow bounded canonical resolution whenever any lawful actor/world causal dependency requires the fact; preserve user-independent truth, query invariance and separately gated disclosure.

risk: The learned attention regime is surfaced as an identity label or gameplay diagnosis, causing users to game the model, internalize a provisional hypothesis as self-truth, and create a self-confirming attention loop.
mitigation_direction: Apply SPD-0241. Separate privacy inspectability from ordinary-play feedback; disclose mechanism generally and use contextual provenance-linked behavioral descriptions only in explicitly requested reflection.

risk: Out-of-world app/control-plane behavior leaks into the simulation as actor knowledge or relationship evidence—for example, Nadia reacts as though she knows the user opened/cancelled Restart, changed settings, inspected privacy data or considered an app action she could not perceive.
mitigation_direction: Apply SPD-0242. Classify interface operations by realization authority; only exact diegetic SAY/DO/ATTEND or separately governed world-transition effects may enter actor/world causality.

risk: User interpretations or recommendations are rewarded by retrofitting unresolved persona history so the player becomes the uniquely insightful healer, missing key or destined developmental solution, creating savior/therapist-game teleology and violating player decentering.
mitigation_direction: Apply SPD-0243 with SPD-0211/0212 and SPD-0205. Keep prior truth/history query-independent; let user contributions become new present causes only through actor-specific uptake and ordinary alternative outcomes.

risk: Gameplay/alpha research interprets a user's nonresponse, attention or choice without knowing what evidence was objectively present, perceptually available, narrated or explicitly acquired, confounding user behavior with product exposure/treatment.
mitigation_direction: Apply SPD-0244. Preserve the minimum exposure/treatment provenance needed for the named inference and separate product-generated exposure from user-originated attention/action.

risk: Findings from Rawlsing's self-selected user population are reported or encoded as population prevalence/universal cultural laws, laundering product convenience sampling into general sociology.
mitigation_direction: Apply SPD-0245. Limit claims to supported sample/scope; use findings for model refinement and hypotheses unless separately governed representative sampling supports broader inference.

risk: The narrator/actor/UI supplies a brand/model/domain label the user could not yet lawfully recognize, or later treats reuse of that supplied terminology as proof of prior expertise, collapsing canonical identity into user knowledge and creating a self-confirming recognition model.
mitigation_direction: Apply SPD-0166/0246/0248. Gate narrator lexical specificity by actual perceptual access and warranted recognition; distinguish raw evidence/readable markings from brand/model/domain classification; preserve identification-source provenance.

risk: Progressive ambient noticing is implemented as an eventual exhaustive scan, so merely remaining in a scene long enough reveals every visible detail, recreating passive omniscience, completionist inventory behavior and devaluing deliberate ATTEND.
mitigation_direction: Apply SPD-0247 with SPD-0020/0161. Keep ambient acquisition bounded, task/load/sightline dependent and nonexhaustive; time enriches a sample rather than guaranteeing total perceptual coverage.

risk: Narration leaks canonical object identity through overly specific lexicalization—for example naming a Vitamix/model, book edition, religious object, technical tool or brand that the user has not lawfully recognized—making the narrator an expertise oracle and erasing differences among users.
mitigation_direction: Apply SPD-0248. Surface generic class/visible morphology first; expose markings only when perceptually readable; reserve brand/model/domain labels for demonstrated or lawfully acquired user recognition.

risk: A user-conditioned phenomenal lens becomes a self-confirming feed: the system infers attention to X, surfaces more X, interprets engagement with the surfaced material as confirmation, and progressively encloses the user inside the model it created.
mitigation_direction: Apply SPD-0263/0264. Keep lens influence weak/contextual/provenance-bearing; preserve conspicuous-reality and explicit-ATTEND overrides; prohibit hidden-salience ranking; support lens inspection/perturbation and counterevidence from independent reality rather than feed optimization.

risk: Phenomenal personalization leaks across the membrane into world generation or actor truth, causing objects/facts to exist, become significant or shape Nadia because they fit the user's inferred interests or theories.
mitigation_direction: Apply SPD-0263. Keep canonical materialization/query invariance and actor causality upstream of user-lens sampling/lexicalization; audit same-world different-lens replays.

risk: Rawlsing covertly shapes the user's phenomenal surface from behavioral modeling without making the mechanism inspectable, turning a pedagogical/reflexive feature into hidden manipulation.
mitigation_direction: Apply SPD-0264 with SPD-0241 and privacy law. Provide general mechanism disclosure plus provenance-linked reflective inspection; never present a user model as identity truth.

risk: Appropriate lexical/cultural references or successful social signaling are promoted into actual subject-matter competence, class origin or procedural skill, causing the system to counterfeit what the user knows or can do.
mitigation_direction: Apply SPD-0265/0266. Preserve evidence provenance and separate lexical familiarity, signaling, recognition, discursive competence, procedural skill and origin.

risk: The system's analytic model of the user leaks into Nadia's actor-local model, making her unnaturally know what the platform inferred about the user and erasing bluffing, misrecognition and social uncertainty.
mitigation_direction: Apply SPD-0263/0265/0266. Nadia updates only from actor-lawful perception/history; system-side user analytics remain non-diegetic unless an exact diegetic event communicates them.

risk: Self-reported capabilities become unrestricted buffs or an escape hatch that restores external wealth/status/professional authority inside homologous-peer mode, weakening material constraint and realism.
mitigation_direction: Apply SPD-0267 and Courts 7/8. Separate embodied skill from structural position; use dimension-specific CARRY/HOMOLOGIZE/BRACKET/USER-SELECT; homologize wealth/power and never treat self-report as external certification.

risk: Reaction/audio/motor microtasks become a central skill economy, causing device quality, latency, disability, age or motor ability to dominate relational outcomes and turning Rawlsing into a peripheral minigame product.
mitigation_direction: Apply SPD-0268. Keep such modalities optional/bounded; preserve simulated/assisted alternatives; make social consequences actor-local rather than universal reward; prohibit leaderboards/reflex progression.

risk: Parser/interface uncertainty is experienced as worldly resistance because the engine chooses an arbitrary interpretation or withholds needed clarification, falsely making the world/person seem difficult.
mitigation_direction: Apply SPD-0261. Separate interface-owned ambiguity from user/world/actor-owned uncertainty; clarify or conservatively realize instead of laundering parser failure into causality.

risk: Preserving the locus of human work is over-applied so every mundane act requires procedural narration and explicit articulation, producing QWOP-by-prose and destroying ordinary conversational/action flow.
mitigation_direction: Apply SPD-0260/0261. Use the counterfactual-hinge test; compress causally equivalent procedure and return only at meaningful user-owned decision boundaries.

risk: Under-decompression lets the engine silently invent the user's joke, argument, explanation, interpretation, objection, timing or social stance, making the product flatter the user with synthetic competence while removing the actual human faculty from the causal chain.
mitigation_direction: Apply SPD-0260/0261. Identify the native semantic payload and return control before engine completion would substitute for user judgment or communication.

risk: Even with green C8 outbox wrapper receipts, the unchanged accepted legacy Journal.commit remains legally callable and in an observed separate process erases three acknowledged occurrences. Unkeyed hashes and local capability tokens can be forged and byte-valid prior history replayed, so future persona/relationship continuity may be counterfeit after a rollback.
mitigation_direction: Require actual D1 accepted writer API disablement/exclusivity across ALL entrypoints, D2 distinct key/monotonic trust anchor and D3 ADP019 event source; preserve independent hostile executed receipts; NEVER treat after-the-fact detection as prevention or self-issued keys as authority.

risk: A causal history generator can green-check hash/DAG replay while violating current material conservation (stock5 consumed6, negative free-hours), manufacturing independently performed participants/afterstates and importing future-child outcomes into earlier recorded sources. A later coherent narrative would then explain a world that never occurred.
mitigation_direction: Require G17 versioned material stock/cost/action source transactions, current afterstate plus independent peer/action source, represented chronological consistency, future-child input/output firewall, 56 inherited regression dispositions and assertion-level actual later-consumer faults; keep science distinct from sourcefree demonstration.
